scope: Page batch 2, B1 queries; deferred events, no embedding serialization
scoring: FP32 NPU dot/max, CPU FP32 per-query sum; full 2560 dimensions; pytrec_eval metrics

qrels_inventory.policy: evaluate only IDs in the selected language query components

page_batch_padding: repeat last valid input row to fixed batch size; discard padded outputs
throughput_page_count: real pages only, including final-batch padding compute cost
scoring_document_padding: zero floor for documents shorter than corpus maximum, matching MTEB global padding
scoring_query_groups: one language at a time; original query order and FP32 MaxSim
aggregation: metrics: mean over queries; macro_metrics: equal mean over languages
timing_semantics: host_s is submission/blocking wall time, not device execution; device_interval_ms can include launch gaps and waits; no inter-section timing barriers
embedding_storage: CPU memory only; released at process exit
